@note: Thai translation for MonzDraw (2026-10-15), machine-made from en.json; not yet reviewed by a native speaker.

@context.shell.bar.area.app: App bar chip and link: the app area for online apps (/app). Keep it short.
@context.shell.bar.area.try: App bar chip and link: the area where the app runs in the web browser (/use). Keep it short.
@context.shell.bar.area.lab: App bar chip and link: the staff test area (/lab). Keep it short.
@context.shell.screen.btn.title: Tooltip of the screen-mode button: {now} = the mode now, {next} = what a click does, {key} = the shortcut.
@context.shell.offline.progress: App bar button while saving: files saved so far of all files.
@context.shell.settings.width: A panel width in rem (a CSS unit, keep 'rem').
@context.shell.panels.moved: Screen-reader announcement: {panel} = the panel's name, {where} = one of shell.panels.where.*.
@context.shell.help.hits: Help search result count; {q} = what was typed.
@context.shell.help.ctx.for: {what} = a list such as 'Mac, Firefox, online' (from shell.help.os/browser/input/net.*).
@context.shell.settings.lang.auto: First choice of the language picker: follow the browser's language.
@context.shell.autosave.meta: {when} = '5 minutes ago' or a date and time; {size} = '2.4 MB' (both formatted for the language).
@context.shell.panels.offer.open: Button after a reload; browsers allow one window per click, so with several windows each click opens the next.
@context.shell.palette.foot: Keep the arrows; they name keys.
@context.shell.assistants.on: Settings › Assistants switch. {app} = the app's name (CadCraft, BimCraft …).
@context.shell.assistants.banner: App bar button while an AI assistant is connected. {name} = the assistant program's own name, as it reports it; keep it short.
@context.shell.assistants.banner.can: {groups} = a list of the short permission names (shell.assistants.short.*).
@context.shell.assistants.undo: In the activity log: {label} = the undo step's name, e.g. "Assistant: LINE".
@context.shell.live.moved.text: A browser page joined to a live session on the host's network; the host handed the session to another Studio. {host} = that person's name.
@context.shell.live.moved.link: {link} = the new host's page address (shown as a link); a code is the short invite code (K7-Q4M2X).
@context.shell.input.family.own: The style family 'each app's own toolbar', filled into 'Every app now uses its {family} style'.
@context.shell.input.key.text: Status line when a shortcut key types text at the command line: {text} = that text.
@context.shell.input.quickbar: Accessible name of the row of buttons under a menu bar: {app} = the app's name.
@context.shell.phone.bar: On a phone: the bar at the bottom of an app with the Tools / Move buttons and one button per panel.
@context.shell.phone.close: On a phone: the button at the top of a panel shown as a sheet; {panel} = the panel's name.
@context.shell.phone.tb.move: On a phone: short label (one word, under an icon) of the button that moves the toolbar between the top and the bottom.
@context.shell.phone.tools: On a phone: short label (one word, under an icon) of the button that shows or hides the toolbar.
